description:
Create, list and show thread files. A thread file is threads/<Kind>/<Name>.md, where Kind is Projects, Processes or Topics.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files, open only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CODE] [--rate N] — create a thread file

Args:
  QUERY: optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity.
  THREAD: thread name or 'Kind/Name'.

Flags:
  list:
    --all   also show paused and closed threads
    --json   JSON output
  show:
    --json   JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME   required; becomes the filename; must not contain '/' or start with '.'
    --kind   required; project, process or topic, stored under Projects/, Processes/ or Topics/
    --category   required; professional, personal or voluntary
    --currency CODE   optional 3-letter ISO code; default currency for `hours`. A thread with no currency is not billable.
    --rate N   optional default hourly rate for `hours`; needs --currency

Examples:
  ["list", "sgb", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]

Notes:
  There is no close or delete subcommand. A thread is closed by setting status: closed and ended: in its frontmatter; nothing moves.
  Exit 1: empty name, a name containing '/' or starting with '.', the thread already exists, or --rate without --currency.
